items.event_title: Northern Star rejects Gold Fields' $27.1 billion takeover proposal
items.news_summary: Northern Star Resources rejected an unsolicited A$38.7 billion ($27.1 billion) takeover proposal from Gold Fields, a deal that would have created one of the world's largest gold producers.
items.investor_materiality: High for GFI, global gold miners and sector consolidation because the rejected bid is large enough to reset M&A expectations and valuation comparisons.
items.selection_reason: Fresh, verified, market-moving M&A with Reuters confirmation and a clear listed-company angle.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters, Sep 28; also independently reflected in the fresh Scanner B evidence set.

items.event_title: China and the United States agree tariff cuts covering $60 billion of goods
items.news_summary: The two countries released product-level tariff reductions covering roughly $60 billion of bilateral goods, including agricultural and household-product categories.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for trade-sensitive U.S. equities, agriculture, consumer goods, inflation expectations and China-exposed supply chains.
items.selection_reason: Fresh Reuters-confirmed policy implementation detail with broad market relevance after the recent leaders' meeting.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters, Sep 28; concrete product-list and tariff-cut details.

items.event_title: China weighs allowing ByteDance and Alibaba to buy Nvidia's new AI chips
items.news_summary: Reporting indicates Chinese authorities may allow selected domestic firms, including ByteDance and Alibaba, to purchase Nvidia's newer AI hardware, potentially easing a key demand constraint.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for NVDA and the broader AI accelerator supply chain because Chinese access can materially affect demand, mix and competitive dynamics.
items.selection_reason: Fresh, high-impact semiconductor policy/demand story with direct U.S.-equity relevance.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report syndicated by Investing.com; underlying report attributed to The Information. Official approval status should still be verified.

items.event_title: India's TakeMe2Space plans orbital-computing satellite launch on SpaceX using Nvidia processors
items.news_summary: TakeMe2Space plans an October 1 SpaceX launch of an orbital-computing satellite carrying Nvidia Orin NX processors and says 23 customers have signed for the mission.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high as an early commercialization signal for edge/orbital computing, Nvidia embedded processors and SpaceX launch demand.
items.selection_reason: Fresh Reuters-reported technology commercialization story with a differentiated AI-infrastructure angle.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters, Sep 28; customer count and hardware details are attributed to the company.

items.event_title: Hong Kong lists eight ETFs aimed at Chinese insurer demand for overseas assets
items.news_summary: Eight new Hong Kong-listed ETFs launched with exposure including South Korean chipmakers, U.S. technology companies and Malaysian large caps as insurers seek more overseas allocation channels.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high for cross-border capital flows and demand for U.S. technology and Asian semiconductor exposure.
items.selection_reason: Fresh Reuters-confirmed product launch that can create incremental institutional demand for global tech and chip baskets.
